pages.title: Choosing a Chest
pages.text: The five chest tiers hold 54, 72, 81, 90, and 108 slots: Brass, Silver, Electrum, Rubracium, and Platinum. Choose a size that suits the workshop rather than splitting the same material across many small chests.

Use the individual chest entries for crafting. Contents are stored with the chest and can be moved through normal inventory automation. Breaking a chest drops its stored items; clear space before dismantling a full store.
